name: Cash Proceeds Definition
definition: Definition of the cash proceeds for a corporate action in generic terms; that is, before applying it to specific securities holding. An example would be the definition of a dividend payment where all the information will be given in general on a per share basis.

CashIncentiveRate.name: Cash Incentive Rate
CashIncentiveRate.definition: Cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event, e.g. consent fees.

ContractualPaymentIndicator.name: Contractual Payment Indicator
ContractualPaymentIndicator.definition: Indicates exceptions to contractual payment service.

IndemnityAmount.name: Indemnity Amount
IndemnityAmount.definition: (Unique to France) Amount due to a buyer of securities dealt prior to ex date which may be subject to different rate of taxation.

CashIncentiveAmount.name: Cash Incentive Amount
CashIncentiveAmount.definition: Rate of the cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event, e.g. consent fees.

PrincipalOrCorpus.name: Principal Or Corpus
PrincipalOrCorpus.definition: Amount of money representing a distribution of a bond's principal, eg, repayment of outstanding debt.

RedemptionPremiumAmount.name: Redemption Premium Amount
RedemptionPremiumAmount.definition: Amount of money (not interest) in addition to the principal at the redemption of a bond.

IncomePortion.name: Income Portion
IncomePortion.definition: Amount relating to the underlying security for which income is distributed.

PaymentCurrency.name: Payment Currency
PaymentCurrency.definition: Currency for the payment of the cash proceeds.

StatusCashAmount.name: Status Cash Amount
StatusCashAmount.definition: Amount of cash subscribed that has been assigned the status indicated.

PriceCalculationMethod.name: Price Calculation Method
PriceCalculationMethod.definition: Specifies the method applied for the calculation of the price.

IncomeType.name: Income Type
IncomeType.definition: Specifies the type of income.|The lists of income type codes to be used, are available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest paid as the proceeds of a CA event.

Dividend.name: Dividend
Dividend.definition: Distribution of earnings to shareholders, paid for in cash, stock, scrip issue or, rarely, in kind, eg, company products or property. The dividend amount is decided by the board of directors.
